List the key launch args (start_server.sh): -name, -port (default 2456, uses 2456-2458 UDP), -world, -password (min length rules), -public 1/0, -savedir, -crossplay, -preset, and the -modifier flags (combat veryeasy/easy/hard/veryhard, deathpenalty casual/veryeasy/hard/hardcore, resources muchless/less/more/muchmore/most, raids none/muchless/.../muchmore, portals casual/hard/veryhard). Also adminlist.txt, bannedlist.txt, permittedlist.txt, and BepInEx config files (BepInEx/config/*.cfg per mod, valheim_plus.cfg). Note the discord/steam server browser flags.

Client app id 892970 for context. Crossplay (PlayFab) note.

Give real GB numbers; note modded (especially RAFT/large bases) needs more. Note dedicated server does not render but is single-thread sensitive.

Based on the search results, here's comprehensive information about Valheim dedicated server world modifier flags and presets:

## World Modifiers Overview

World Modifiers let you fine-tune your Valheim server's difficulty across five independent categories. World modifiers include combat, death penalty, resources, raids and portals.

## Modifier Categories

Modifiers control enemy health, damage, and spawn rates (combat), how much skill XP you lose on death (death penalty), how much you gather from trees, rocks, and other resource nodes (resources), how frequently enemy raids attack your base (raids), and what items can be transported through portals (portals).

## Presets

Valheim offers presets including Normal (default everything), Casual (easier combat, no death penalty, resources up, portals unrestricted), Hard (tougher enemies, more punishing death, restricted portals), and Hardcore (permadeath).

## Setting Modifiers on Dedicated Servers

Each modifier is a separate -modifier <category> <value> flag, and you can chain as many as you need, for example -modifier combat hard -modifier resources more -modifier portals casual.

For a casual group, use -preset casual for a quick baseline, or tune individually: -modifier combat easy, -modifier deathpenalty casual, -modifier resources more, and -modifier portals casual.

## Special toggles (setkey)

Popular setkey toggles include NoMap (hides the map and minimap), PassiveMobs (enemies won't attack), NoPortals (disables portal use), NoBuildCost (build without consuming materials), PlayerEvents (ties raid events to player-specific progress), and TeleportAll (allows all items through portals).

# Valheim World Modifiers & Server Settings Summary

## World Modifier Categories & Values

**Combat:** "Very Easy, Easy, Standard, Hard and Very Hard"

**Death Penalty:** "Casual (no skill loss, keep everything) through Very Easy, Easy, Standard, Hard and up to Hardcore"

**Resources:** "Much Less, Less, Standard, More, Much More, Most" (approximately 0.5× to 3× normal rate)

**Raids (Events):** "None through Much Less, Less, Standard, More and Much More"

**Portals:** Ranges from carrying everything through portals, to standard restrictions on metals, to complete disabling

## Difficulty Presets

The guide lists six bundled presets: Standard, Casual, Easy, Hard, Hardcore, Immersive, and Hammer (Creative).

## Global Setkey Toggles

## Overview
The framework everyone runs is BepInEx, the install method everyone uses is Thunderstore (paired with the r2modman or Thunderstore Mod Manager desktop apps).

Visit Thunderstore (the main Valheim mod repository) and download BepInExPack_Valheim. On a dedicated server, you extract the contents into the server's root directory (next to valheim_server.x86_64 on Linux, next to valheim_server.exe on Windows).

## Client-Server Synchronization
Everyone must have identical versions installed. Every .dll mod running on the server must also be installed in each player's /BepInEx/plugins/ folder.

## Using r2modman for Version Matching
In r2modman, create a profile for your server and add every gameplay mod you want, at the versions you want. Let r2modman pull in dependencies (most mods list BepInExPack_Valheim as a dependency, so it's handled for you). Use r2modman's export profile feature to produce a shareable code or file. Send it to every player so they import the identical profile — instant version match.

## ServerSync and Configuration
Mods like ValheimPlus enforce config synchronization. Share your server's .cfg files from /BepInEx/config/ with players, especially if enforceConfiguration is enabled.

# Valheim Dedicated Server Hosting — Product Options Research (Aug 2026)

## 1. Editions / versions to offer as a picker

**Game version & roadmap (verified current):**
- Valheim is still in early access as of Aug 2026. Major updates shipped so far: Hearth & Home (Sep 2021), Mistlands (Dec 2022), **Ashlands (May 2024)**, and **Call to Arms (early 2026)**.
- **Deep North** is the final planned biome and ships with the **1.0 release on September 9, 2026**, ending early access and adding **PS5 + Nintendo Switch 2** with full crossplay. Your wizard should be ready to surface a "1.0 / Deep North" branch the day it lands, and expect a mod-compatibility break at that version bump.
- Sources: https://gamerant.com/valheim-deep-north-biome-1-0-update-rumors-leaks-features-info/ , https://supercraft.host/article/valheim-roadmap-2026/

**Mod loader (verified):** **BepInEx** is the universal loader — specifically the **BepInExPack_Valheim** distributed on Thunderstore (current pack line 5.4.22xx). Every modded edition sits on this. Source: https://valheim.thunderstore.io/

**ValheimPlus situation (verified — important):**
- The **original valheimPlus/ValheimPlus is unmaintained.** The live successor is the **Grantapher fork** (`Grantapher/ValheimPlus`), published as **"ValheimPlus Grantapher Temporary"** on Thunderstore and on Nexus/GitHub. Latest release ~0.9.16.2, compatible with Valheim 0.220.3 + BepInExPack 5.4.2202, actively maintained into 2025.
- Reality: the community has largely **shifted toward individual modular mods** (Azu* suite, etc.) rather than the monolithic V+ config, but V+ Grantapher is still the single most-requested "all-in-one tweaks" option, so offer it as a named edition.
- Sources: https://github.com/Grantapher/ValheimPlus/releases , https://valheim.thunderstore.io/package/Grantapher/ValheimPlus_Grantapher_Temporary/

**Suggested edition picker:**
1. **Vanilla (clean)** — no loader.
2. **Vanilla + BepInEx (empty)** — loader pre-installed, ready for owner's own mods.
3. **ValheimPlus (Grantapher)** — V+ preconfigured.
4. **Curated modpack** — a Thunderstore profile of popular QoL mods (see §2).

**Native world-modifiers / presets as picker options (verified):** Valheim ships in-game difficulty controls that the dedicated server accepts as launch flags — these should be first-class wizard toggles, not something owners edit by hand. Five categories: **combat, deathpenalty, resources, raids, portals**, plus special keys (NoMap, PassiveMobs, NoPortals, NoBuildCost, PlayerEvents, TeleportAll). Presets: **Normal/Standard, Casual, Easy, Hard, Hardcore, Immersive, Hammer (Creative)**. Full values in §3. Source: https://xgamingserver.com/blog/valheim-world-modifiers-server-settings/

---

## 2. Top mods ecosystem (one-click expectations)

**Distribution platform (verified):** **Thunderstore** (valheim.thunderstore.io) is THE Valheim mod database. Client-side, players use **r2modman** or the **Thunderstore Mod Manager** desktop apps. Source: https://valheim.thunderstore.io/

**Server-side install mechanism (verified):**
- Download **BepInExPack_Valheim** from Thunderstore, extract into the server root (next to `valheim_server.x86_64` on Linux). Drop mod `.dll`s into `BepInEx/plugins/`, tune `.cfg`s in `BepInEx/config/`, restart.
- **Clients must run identical mod versions.** Every gameplay `.dll` on the server must also be in each player's `BepInEx/plugins/`. Best UX: r2modman **export-profile → shareable code** so players import an identical profile.
- Many mods use **ServerSync** (or V+'s `enforceConfiguration`) to push the server's config to clients automatically — a big reason to offer a "share config" download button.
- Sources: https://pinehosting.com/blog/how-to-add-mods-to-your-valheim-server-a-step-by-step-guide-and-troubleshooting/ , https://xgamingserver.com/blog/how-to-add-install-mods-to-a-dedicated-valheim-server/

**Top mods owners expect one-click (verified via Thunderstore most-downloaded, Aug 2026):**
| Mod | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **BepInExPack_Valheim** | The loader (dependency of everything) — ~6.3M |
| **Jotunn (JVL)** | Core modding library — ~4M; dependency of many content mods |
| **HookGenPatcher / ConfigurationManager** | Common dependencies / in-game config UI |
| **PlantEverything** | Plant all flora/trees — ~2.3M |
| **EpicLoot** | Loot drops, magic items, enchanting — ~1.9M |
| **AzuCraftyBoxes** | Craft from nearby containers — ~1.4M |
| **AzuExtendedPlayerInventory (AzuEPI)** | Extra inventory rows, equipment + quick slots — ~1.3M |
| **Warfare / Armory / Monstrum (Bowei/others)** | Content: weapons, armor, monsters |
| **CreatureLevelAndLootControl** | Tune creature levels/loot — ~1.1M |
| **Server devcommands** | Admin/cheat commands on dedicated servers — ~1M |
| **Quick Stack – Store – Sort – Trash – Restock** | Inventory QoL — ~800K |
| **PlantEasily / OdinArchitect / OdinHorse** | Grid planting, building, mounts |
| **ExtraSlots / Equipment and Quick Slots** | Hotbar/equipment slots |

Also commonly requested and worth stocking in a curated pack: **Valheim RAFT** (sailable rafts/bases — note: heavy RAM), **AutoMapPins**, **Better Wards**, **ServerCharacters** (server-side character storage / anti-cheat), **BetterUI/BetterArchery**, **WackyDB / adventure backpacks**. Source: Thunderstore most-downloaded — https://thunderstore.io/c/valheim/?ordering=most-downloaded

---

## 3. Key editable config / knobs

Valheim's dedicated server is **driven almost entirely by launch args in `start_server.sh`**, not a big config file.

**Core launch args (verified):**
- `-name "<server name>"` — display name in browser.
- `-port 2456` — **default 2456; server uses the UDP range 2456–2458** (query port = port+1). Expose all three.
- `-world "<worldname>"` — world/save file name.
- `-password "<pw>"` — **minimum 5 characters; cannot be contained in the server name.** Empty only allowed with `-public 0` in some setups.
- `-public 1|0` — `1` lists the server on the Steam community server browser; `0` = unlisted (join by IP/join-code only).
- `-savedir <path>` — relocates worlds/`adminlist.txt` etc. (key for multi-tenant isolation).
- `-crossplay` — enables **PlayFab crossplay** (Xbox/Game Pass/console players; also enables the crossplay join-code browser). Toggle it.
- `-preset <name>` — applies a bundled difficulty preset (normal/casual/easy/hard/hardcore/immersive/hammer).
- `-modifier <category> <value>` — chainable, per-category difficulty (below).
- `-setkey <key>` — global toggles (below).
- `-instanceid`, `-backups`, `-backupshort`, `-backuplong`, `-logfile`, `-saveinterval` — instance ID, backup cadence, logging.

Sources: https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Dedicated_servers , https://xgamingserver.com/blog/valheim-world-modifiers-server-settings/

**World-modifier values (verified — make these dropdowns):**
- **combat**: `veryeasy, easy, standard/normal, hard, veryhard`
- **deathpenalty**: `casual, veryeasy, easy, standard, hard, hardcore`
- **resources**: `muchless, less, standard, more, muchmore, most` (~0.5×–3×)
- **raids**: `none, muchless, less, standard, more, muchmore`
- **portals**: `casual` (everything through portals), `standard` (metals restricted), `hard`/`veryhard` (no portals)
- Example: `-modifier combat hard -modifier resources more -modifier portals casual`

**Setkey toggles (checkboxes):** `nomap`, `passivemobs`, `noportals`, `nobuildcost`, `playerevents`, `teleportall`.

**Access-control files (verified — live in the save/config dir):**
- `adminlist.txt` — SteamID64s with admin/devcommand rights.
- `bannedlist.txt` — banned SteamID64s.
- `permittedlist.txt` — whitelist (only these IDs may join).
Expose all three as editable lists in the panel.

**BepInEx config (modded editions):** `BepInEx/config/*.cfg` — one `.cfg` per mod; `valheim_plus.cfg` (Grantapher) for the V+ edition. Offer an in-panel editor + a "download config to share with players" button (for ServerSync/enforceConfiguration mods).

---

## 4. SteamCMD app ID + acquisition / update

- **Valheim Dedicated Server app ID = 896660** (VERIFIED). Client app ID **892970** (context only).
- Install/update: `steamcmd +force_install_dir <dir> +login anonymous +app_update 896660 validate +quit`. Optional `-beta public` (or a named beta branch for pre-release testing).
- **Update flow:** when the game pushes an update, the server must be updated (`+app_update 896660`) and **restarted**; clients auto-update via Steam, so a lagging server rejects everyone with a version mismatch — auto-update-on-restart is high value.
- **BepInEx after updates:** BepInEx itself usually survives content updates (engine rarely changes), but you should **re-verify/re-run the BepInEx install after each update** and confirm the load line in the startup log; mod `.dll`s frequently need version bumps at biome updates (expect breakage at the 1.0/Deep North bump Sep 9 2026).
- **Known gotcha (VERIFIED):** for BepInEx to hook, `steam_appid.txt` must contain **892970** (the client ID), not 896660 or missing — a classic "mods silently don't load" failure your provisioner should handle automatically.
- **Crossplay:** uses **PlayFab**; enabled with `-crossplay`, gives a join-code/crossplay browser alongside the Steam browser.
- Sources: https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Dedicated_servers , https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/issues/548 , https://xgamingserver.com/blog/how-to-add-install-mods-to-a-dedicated-valheim-server/

---

## 5. Resource baseline (RAM/CPU per tier)

Valheim caps at **10 players**, so RAM demand tops out early and is driven by **world exploration/size + building/terraforming**, not just player count. Loaded zones (where players are active) each cost ~100–300 MB; a fresh world idles ~1.8–2.4 GB.

| Tier | Players | Vanilla RAM | Modded RAM | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small | 2–5 | 4 GB | 6 GB | 4 GB comfortable vanilla |
| Standard | up to 10 | 4–6 GB | 8 GB | heavy building/terraform pushes 5–6 GB |
| Heavy/modded | 10 (+V+ over-cap) | — | 8–12 GB | RAFT / large bases / big modpacks |

**CPU:** the dedicated server **does not render**, but is **single-thread sensitive** — clock speed matters more than core count. A **>3.0 GHz** core is the difference between smooth and laggy exploration at 8–10 players; V+ raising the cap past ~15–20 degrades regardless of RAM. Sell CPU-per-server (pinned fast core), not just RAM.

Sources: https://dedicatedgameservers.net/articles/valheim-dedicated-server-requirements-2026/ , https://help.sparkedhost.com/en/article/how-much-ram-does-a-valheim-server-need-1xg42jc/ , https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Dedicated_servers

## 6. "What we're missing" — highest-value additions

1. **Native world-modifier / preset picker in the wizard** — dropdowns for combat/deathpenalty/resources/raids/portals + preset shortcut + setkey checkboxes (nomap, passivemobs, playerevents, etc.). This is pure vanilla functionality most panels bury; it's the #1 buildable win and needs no mods.
2. **BepInEx one-click + Thunderstore mod installer** — install BepInExPack_Valheim on demand, then a browse/install-by-slug flow against Thunderstore, and re-verify BepInEx after each game update (incl. the `steam_appid.txt = 892970` fix). Ship a **curated modpack edition** (Jotunn + Azu suite + EpicLoot + PlantEverything + Server devcommands).
3. **"Share config with players" export** — one button to bundle the server's `BepInEx/config/*.cfg` (and the r2modman profile code) so ServerSync/enforceConfiguration clients match instantly. Directly cuts the #1 modded-server support ticket ("version/config mismatch").
4. **Crossplay toggle + join-code display** — expose `-crossplay` and surface the PlayFab join code in the panel; important for console/Game Pass friends.
5. **World upload/download + auto-backup restore** — let owners import an existing `.db/.fwl` world pair and download backups; pair with **auto-update-on-restart** (app_update 896660) and admin/ban/permit list editors for `adminlist.txt`/`bannedlist.txt`/`permittedlist.txt`.

A **ValheimPlus (Grantapher) config editor** is a nice-to-have edition, but note the ecosystem's drift toward modular mods — don't make V+ the centerpiece; the modifier picker + Thunderstore installer serve more owners.
